name: Chapter 02 — The Key Registry
status: offline rule model with a real signature path; not published and not deployed

pinned_sources.version_policy: pinned; later draft changes are not followed automatically

evidence_tiers.shows: the acceptance and refusal conditions transcribed from the proposal text behave as written
evidence_tiers.does_not_show: any cryptographic property, and any claim about the network

evidence_tiers.shows: the model against the 29 pinned upstream test functions for this operation
evidence_tiers.does_not_show: agreement on ordering, because the upstream feature specification body was not captured

evidence_tiers.shows: one genuinely signed registration accepted and four genuinely forged ones refused, using upstream leanXMSS and BLS code
evidence_tiers.does_not_show: the full proposal, its signing-domain choices, or its security

evidence_tiers.shows: no divergence between the model and a separately written oracle over the enumerated space
evidence_tiers.does_not_show: absence of divergence outside that space

evidence_tiers.shows: the deciding procedure flags each injected fault once the probe set covers it
evidence_tiers.does_not_show: a finding; injected faults are labelled calibration and are never reported as discoveries

artifacts: private per-call capture and cost record, kept outside this tree
evidence_tiers.shows: after the repair, one round evaluated eight sequences over thirty-two comparisons with full agreement, and an earlier round surfaced four disagreements traced to our own written statement of a fixture, which was then fixed and pinned by an offline regression test
evidence_tiers.does_not_show: a protocol finding: the disagreements were between two statements we wrote, not between the draft and an implementation. The guardian role was priced on one adjudication whose prompt disclosed the fix already made, so that reply is corroboration and not an independent review

rules_exercised: a validator that has initiated an exit cannot register
the registration must name the epoch of the change it follows
only an already-registered validator is rate limited
the signing key of the validator authorizes the registration
the new key must not be the current key of any validator
the proof of possession must use the reserved leaf and bind both identities
by_design_not_vulnerabilities: the signing key keeps the right to replace a registered key during the registration period
a VRF root may repeat across validators and openings are not checked by this draft
a key released by a change becomes available again
an unregistered validator holds an unset entry that does not occupy the zero key
not_implemented: leaf allocation inside a signer and fault re-signing
gossip, per-block limits, parent execution requests and chain reorganization
the fork upgrade and the parallel-list invariant
the live two-model round, which needs a credential held only on the production host
publication, deployment and any production call rate change

public_output_rules.hashing: computed over the redacted public payload only
